name: Care-Trust Evidence
opening: A tool case is reported missing. A second support record names the same worker. Did private information leave the care team?
adaptation: Existing tools and parcel facts replace the proposed jewellery losses. Existing reported entry damage is not rewritten as unlocked entry.
scope: Five existing incidents, two new fictional documentary contacts, sixteen supplementary evidence items; no new incidents or entitlements.
